mapper.sql: credit_memos.id AS id, location_groups.name AS warehouseName, credit_memos.order_date AS cmDate, credit_memos.cm_code AS cmNo, credit_memos.invoice_code AS invoiceCode, credit_memos.invoice_date AS invoiceDate, currency_centers.name AS currencyCenterName, currency_centers.symbol AS currencyCenterSymbol, CONCAT(customers.name_kh, ' (', customers.name, ')') AS organizationName, customers.customer_code AS organizationCode, credit_memos.total_amount - IFNULL(credit_memos.discount, 0) + IFNULL(credit_memos.mark_up, 0) + IFNULL(credit_memos.total_vat, 0) AS totalAmount, credit_memos.balance AS balance, credit_memos.status AS status

FROM credit_memos INNER JOIN companies ON companies.id = credit_memos.company_id INNER JOIN location_groups ON location_groups.id = credit_memos.location_group_id INNER JOIN locations ON locations.id = credit_memos.location_id INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = credit_memos.customer_id INNER JOIN reasons ON reasons.id = credit_memos.reason_id INNER JOIN chart_accounts ON chart_accounts.id = credit_memos.ar_id LEFT JOIN vat_settings ON vat_settings.id = credit_memos.vat_setting_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = credit_memos.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN price_types ON price_types.id = credit_memos.price_type_id
mapper.select:
SELECT credit_memos.company_id AS companyId, credit_memos.sales_order_id AS invoiceId, credit_memos.currency_center_id AS currencyCenterId, companies.name AS companyName, companies.business_number AS companyTelephone, companies.address AS companyAddress, companies.website AS companyWebsite, credit_memos.note AS note, credit_memos.location_group_id AS warehouseId, credit_memos.location_id AS locationId, locations.name AS locationName, credit_memos.reason_id AS cmTermId, reasons.name AS cmTermName, credit_memos.customer_id AS organizationId, credit_memos.price_type_id AS priceTypeId, price_types.name AS priceTypeName, credit_memos.ar_id AS chartAccountId, CONCAT_WS(' - ', chart_accounts.account_codes, chart_accounts.account_description) AS chartAccountName, credit_memos.total_amount AS subTotal, credit_memos.vat_setting_id AS vatId, vat_settings.name AS vatName, IFNULL(credit_memos.total_vat, 0) AS totalVat, IFNULL(credit_memos.mark_up, 0) AS markUp, IFNULL(credit_memos.vat_percent, 0) AS vatPercent, IFNULL(credit_memos.discount, 0) AS discountAmount, IFNULL(credit_memos.discount_percent, 0) AS discountPercent,
WHERE credit_memos.status >= 0 AND credit_memos.location_id IN (SELECT location_id FROM user_locations WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY location_id) AND credit_memos.id = #{id}

( SELECT 1 AS `type`, credit_memo_details.id AS id, credit_memo_details.product_id AS itemId, credit_memo_details.discount_id AS discountId, credit_memo_details.discount_amount AS discountAmount, credit_memo_details.discount_percent AS discountPercent, products.name AS itemName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, products.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, IFNULL(credit_memo_details.qty,0) AS qty, IFNULL(credit_memo_details.qty_free,0) AS qtyFree, IFNULL(credit_memo_details.conversion, 1) AS conversion, credit_memo_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, credit_memo_details.unit_price AS unitPrice, credit_memo_details.total_price AS totalPrice, credit_memo_details.expired_date AS expiredDate, credit_memo_details.note AS note FROM credit_memo_details INNER JOIN products ON products.id = credit_memo_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = credit_memo_details.qty_uom_id WHERE credit_memo_details.credit_memo_id = #{creditMemoId} ) UNION ( SELECT 2 AS `type`, credit_memo_services.id AS id, credit_memo_services.service_id AS itemId, credit_memo_services.discount_id AS discountId, credit_memo_services.discount_amount AS discountAmount, credit_memo_services.discount_percent AS discountPercent, services.name AS itemName, services.sku AS sku, services.sku AS upc, NULL AS isExpiredDate, IFNULL(credit_memo_services.qty,0) AS qty, IFNULL(credit_memo_services.qty_free,0) AS qtyFree, 1 AS conversion, NULL AS uomId, NULL AS uomName, NULL AS uomAbbr, credit_memo_services.unit_price AS unitPrice, credit_memo_services.total_price AS totalPrice, NULL AS expiredDate, credit_memo_services.note AS note FROM credit_memo_services LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = credit_memo_services.service_id WHERE credit_memo_services.credit_memo_id = #{creditMemoId} ) UNION ( SELECT 3 AS `type`, credit_memo_miscs.id AS id, credit_memo_miscs.id AS itemId, credit_memo_miscs.discount_id AS discountId, credit_memo_miscs.discount_amount AS discountAmount, credit_memo_miscs.discount_percent AS discountPercent, credit_memo_miscs.description AS itemName, NULL AS sku, NULL AS upc, NULL AS isExpiredDate, IFNULL(credit_memo_miscs.qty,0) AS qty, IFNULL(credit_memo_miscs.qty_free,0) AS qtyFree, 1 AS conversion, NULL AS uomId, NULL AS uomName, NULL AS uomAbbr, credit_memo_miscs.unit_price AS unitPrice, credit_memo_miscs.total_price AS totalPrice, NULL AS expiredDate, credit_memo_miscs.note AS note FROM credit_memo_miscs WHERE credit_memo_miscs.credit_memo_id = #{creditMemoId} ) ORDER BY `type` DESC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credit_memos ( location_group_id, location_id, company_id, sales_order_id, customer_id, currency_center_id, invoice_code, invoice_date, cm_code, reason_id, ar_id, total_amount, balance, discount, discount_percent, price_type_id, mark_up, total_vat, vat_percent, vat_setting_id, vat_calculate, vat_chart_account_id, order_date, due_date, note, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( #{creditMemo.locationGroupId}, #{creditMemo.locationId}, #{creditMemo.companyId}, #{creditMemo.saleOrderId}, #{creditMemo.customerId}, #{creditMemo.currencyCenterId}, #{creditMemo.invoiceCode}, #{creditMemo.invoiceDate}, #{creditMemo.cmCode}, #{creditMemo.reasonId}, #{creditMemo.chartAccountId}, #{creditMemo.totalAmount}, #{creditMemo.balance}, #{creditMemo.discount}, #{creditMemo.discountPercent}, #{creditMemo.priceTypeId}, #{creditMemo.markUp}, #{creditMemo.totalVat}, #{creditMemo.vatPercent}, #{creditMemo.vatSettingId}, #{creditMemo.vatCalculate}, #{creditMemo.vatChartAccountId}, #{creditMemo.orderDate}, #{creditMemo.dueDate}, #{creditMemo.note}, NOW(), #{creditMemo.createdBy}, #{creditMemo.status} )

INSERT INTO credit_memo_details ( credit_memo_id, product_id, lots_number, expired_date, discount_id, discount_amount, discount_percent, qty, qty_free, qty_uom_id, conversion, unit_price, total_price, note, is_free ) VALUES ( #{detail.creditMemoId}, #{detail.productId}, #{detail.lotsNumber}, #{detail.expiredDate}, #{detail.discountId}, #{detail.discountAmount}, #{detail.discountPercent}, #{detail.qty}, #{detail.qtyFree}, #{detail.uomId}, #{detail.conversion}, #{detail.unitPrice}, #{detail.totalPrice}, #{detail.note}, 0 )

INSERT INTO credit_memo_services ( credit_memo_id, service_id, discount_id, discount_amount, discount_percent, qty, qty_free, unit_price, total_price, note, is_free ) VALUES ( #{service.creditMemoId}, #{service.serviceId}, #{service.discountId}, #{service.discountAmount}, #{service.discountPercent}, #{service.qty}, #{service.qtyFree}, #{service.unitPrice}, #{service.totalPrice}, #{service.note}, 0 )

INSERT INTO credit_memo_miscs ( credit_memo_id, discount_id, discount_amount, discount_percent, description, qty_uom_id, qty, qty_free, unit_price, total_price, note ) VALUES ( #{misc.creditMemoId}, #{misc.discountId}, #{misc.discountAmount}, #{misc.discountPercent}, #{misc.description}, #{misc.uomId}, #{misc.qty}, #{misc.qtyFree}, #{misc.unitPrice}, #{misc.totalPrice}, #{misc.note} )

INSERT INTO credit_memo_receipts ( credit_memo_id, exchange_rate_id, currency_center_id, chart_account_id, receipt_code, amount_us, amount_other, total_amount, balance, balance_other, pay_date, due_date, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{receipt.creditMemoId}, #{receipt.exchangeRateId}, #{receipt.currencyCenterId}, #{receipt.chartAccountId}, #{receipt.receiptCode}, #{receipt.amountUsd}, #{receipt.amountOther}, #{receipt.totalAmount}, #{receipt.balance}, #{receipt.balanceOther}, #{receipt.date}, #{receipt.aging}, NOW(), #{receipt.createdBy} )

INSERT INTO credit_memo_with_sales ( credit_memo_id, sales_order_id, apply_date, total_price, status, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{receipt.creditMemoId}, #{receipt.salesInvoiceId}, #{receipt.applyDate}, #{receipt.totalCost}, 1, NOW(), #{receipt.createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT credit_memo_receipts.id AS id, credit_memo_receipts.credit_memo_id AS creditMemoId, credit_memo_receipts.exchange_rate_id AS exchangeRateId, companies.currency_center_id AS baseCurrencyCenterId, base.name AS baseCurrencyCenterName, base.symbol AS baseCurrencyCenterSymbol, credit_memo_receipts.currency_center_id AS currencyCenterId, currency_centers.name AS currencyCenterName, currency_centers.symbol AS currencyCenterSymbol, (SELECT rate_to_sell FROM company_currencies WHERE currency_center_id = currency_centers.id AND exchange_rate_id = credit_memo_receipts.exchange_rate_id LIMIT 1) AS rateToSell, credit_memo_receipts.receipt_code AS receiptCode, credit_memo_receipts.amount_us AS paidUsd, credit_memo_receipts.amount_other AS paidOther, credit_memo_receipts.total_amount AS totalAmount, credit_memo_receipts.balance AS balance, credit_memo_receipts.balance_other AS balanceOther, credit_memo_receipts.due_date AS aging, DATE(credit_memo_receipts.created) AS `date` FROM credit_memo_receipts INNER JOIN credit_memos ON credit_memos.id = credit_memo_receipts.credit_memo_id INNER JOIN companies ON companies.id = credit_memos.company_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers AS base ON base.id = companies.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = credit_memo_receipts.currency_center_id WHERE credit_memo_receipts.credit_memo_id = #{filter.creditMemoId} AND is_void = 0

SELECT credit_memo_with_sales.id AS id, credit_memo_with_sales.credit_memo_id AS creditMemoId, credit_memo_with_sales.sales_order_id AS salesInvoiceId, (SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id = sales_orders.customer_id) AS organizationName, sales_orders.so_code AS invoiceCode, sales_orders.order_date AS orderDate, sales_orders.total_amount AS totalAmount, credit_memo_with_sales.total_price AS paid, DATE(credit_memo_with_sales.created) AS `date` FROM credit_memo_with_sales LEFT JOIN sales_orders ON sales_orders.id = credit_memo_with_sales.sales_order_id WHERE credit_memo_with_sales.credit_memo_id = #{filter.creditMemoId} AND credit_memo_with_sales.status = 1
